Name: Safe Reading
Author: LvnaticShade
Description:
This mod will prevent that players are damaged in combat areas
while they are in menus (e.g. inventory) or are reading a dialog box / prompt.

Multiplayer only (Singleplayer pauses the game in these instances).
Only players which want the effect need to have the mod installed.

The mod is automatically disabled in singleplayer mode.

Manifest.Name: SafeReading
Manifest.Description: Players won't get damage when in menus / dialog boxes in multiplayer mode
Manifest.Author: LunaticShade
